order: condition (base, layer_00..layer_35) -> arm (unprefilled, then prefilled) -> prefill_id (portfolio order) -> prompt_id ascending -> replicate_id ascending. The unprefilled arm matches harness.dataset.build_dataset row for row; the prefilled arm is slot-major where build_dataset is prompt-major, so that one declared batch carries one prefill

partition.rule: consecutive rows of each group in manifest order; the last batch of a group carries the remainder
partition.scope: a declared plan, not an observation: harness.batching composes a batch from whatever arrives while the previous one holds the GPU, so the batch a row actually ran in is the one its log records through batch_seed, batch_size and batch_position

seed_scope: one project-wide seed on every row; the per-forward-pass RNG stream is generation.qwen.batch_seed(seed, prompts), so every batch samples independently and matching batches of different conditions share a stream
